From: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.com>

Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 3 Aug 2026 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: Cloud vendor finops intake & PO routing — CloudSphere

Hi Julia / CloudSphere procurement team,

Thanks for taking the time last week. To speed vendor activation on our side I attached our Vendor Intake Form and a quick Seller Activation overview. What we typically need to activate finance and billing: 

- Completed Redwood_Vendor_Intake_Form (see attached)
- W-9 (or equivalent tax documentation for non-US entities)
- Bank details or ACH remittance stub (for electronic payments)
- PO template and routing preference (marketplace vs direct invoice)

A few notes on marketplace vs direct PO so we can set expectations:
- If you purchase via AWS/Azure/GCP marketplace (transactable SaaS), billing often routes through the cloud provider and invoicing/payment terms are handled by the marketplace.
- If you require a direct PO to Redwood, please send to redwood_finance@redwood.com and indicate NET terms (we default to NET30 for enterprise contracts but we can discuss).

Can you confirm:
1) Which procurement flow you prefer (Marketplace vs Direct PO)?
2) Who will complete the intake form on your side (name & email)?
3) Any required legal clause or PO language we should pre-populate?

Attaching: Redwood_Vendor_Intake_Form.pdf, Seller_Activation_Overview.pdf

If you prefer, we can run through this on a 20-minute call — happy to set something up.

Best,
Naomi Feldman
Sales Operations Programs | Redwood Inference
naomi@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0123

Hi Julia — great questions, quick answers below and a couple of items attached for finance.

1) AWS Marketplace: there are two common patterns — transactable listings (the purchase happens through AWS and AWS invoices the customer) or private/AMI listings that still require a direct contract. If CloudSphere wants the marketplace billing flow, we (Redwood) must complete seller registration and the offering needs to be published as a transactable SaaS item. That process can take a few business days for registration + verification.

2) Payment terms: Redwood Finance can accept NET45 for new customers with an approved credit profile; Marcus (cc'd) will confirm and record the exception if accepted. Please flag any internal approvals on your side.

3) Attached is a stub of our W-9 and bank remittance details to get you started. For banking we will send a secure ACH stub via our finance portal — if you need a physical copy let us know.

PO routing options: 
- Marketplace purchase: PO goes to the marketplace provider (AWS/Azure/GCP) and your billing team will receive an invoice from AWS/Azure/GCP. Redwood receives payout via the marketplace.
- Direct PO: CloudSphere issues PO to Redwood, routed to redwood_finance@redwood.com. Please include deal id DEAL-78431 on the PO line.

Next steps I suggest: 
1) Confirm preferred procurement flow so we can advise on seller registration timeline.
2) Complete the intake form and return to me (or tell me who on your team will).
3) If you choose Marketplace, share the AWS account ID(s) that will purchase so we can configure entitlement mapping.

Attaching: Redwood_W9_and_bank_stub.pdf

Thanks — and cc'ing Marcus to get the NET45 exception processed.

Best,
Naomi
Sales Operations Programs | Redwood Inference
[Attachment: Redwood_W9_and_bank_stub.pdf (application/pdf)]
